status_as_of_cutoff: As of 2026-08-11, POR03D remains best classified as announced/local process rather than construction or energized. STACK's current project page describes a 55-acre POR03 campus with approximately 200 MW total critical capacity, 72 MW operational, 25 MW near-term availability, and 96 MW expansion capacity; the same page lists POR03D as 220,000 sq ft and 25 MW. A 2026 DCD report says STACK's 121 MW POR03D/E/F expansion starts with POR03D, targeted for Q4 2027, followed by POR03E and POR03F. Oregon DEQ's Cleaner Air Oregon page for SI POR03 identifies a prospective data center at 4735 NE Starr Blvd with a Standard ACDP application and 49 proposed 3,000 kW diesel emergency generators; DEQ approved the Level 3 risk assessment on 2021-04-07. Hillsboro enacted a 120-day land-use moratorium on 2026-07-27 for new or expanded data center/BESS primary-use applications, while allowing projects with applications submitted before the moratorium to continue. No Hillsboro project-specific final land-use decision, building permit, grading/stormwater permit, inspection, CO, utility/interconnection, energization, or commissioning record was located for POR03D.
